item.title: Jigsaw no Machi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sakura Soft
  • 発売日: 1999-05-28
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ジグソーの街
  • 英語名: Jigsaw no Machi

あらすじ

Hero works as a private detective. One night while investigating a yakuza case he notices a girl he knows from somewhere. He saw her in a mysterious dream. He feels like his past also changed after the meeting. The Jigsaw puzzle started to collect together. To unveil the secret he needs a month. Hero and that girl shared a dream six years ago. Now hero chooses to live a new life in a dream. And with the last piece of Jigsaw puzzle set in place, a new town appears in front of him.

item.title: Ashita Sekai ga Owaru Yoru ni
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sakura Soft
  • 発売日: 1998-10-09
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 明日世界が終わる夜に
  • 英語名: Ashita Sekai ga Owaru Yoru ni

别名

  • Sudden Death Night

あらすじ

When hero Shinpei goes to school on Friday a strange rumor of the end of the world the next day spreads. Everyone gets crazy and the school shuts down preventing anyone leaving. Shinpei does not believe in that rumor, but he has to await for the morning in this agitated atmosphere.
